title: Servo Current — Minor Variance
description: Servo current on {val}-axis shows {val2}% variance vs. baseline on identical move profile. No limit exceeded.
probable_cause: Normal mechanical variation or minor lubrication change.
required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.
escalation_path: If AXS-MN-001 is not addressed (log fault. monitor parameters. schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.), the fault will escalate in this order: AXS-SR-002. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
